# lecture landmarks

```{r}


landmarks <- read_excel("data/Date_landmark.xlsx") |> 
  mutate(DEBUT_EXP = as.Date(DEBUT_EXP),
         DEBUT_CW = as.Date(DEBUT_CW),
         FIN_CW = as.Date(FIN_CW),
         DEBUT_FLO = as.Date(DEBUT_FLO),
         FIN_FLO = as.Date(FIN_FLO),
         FIN_EXP = as.Date(FIN_EXP)) |> 
  mutate(DUREE_AU = as.numeric(DEBUT_CW - DEBUT_EXP),
         DUREE_CW = as.numeric(FIN_CW - DEBUT_CW),
         DUREE_BO = as.numeric(DEBUT_FLO - FIN_CW),
         DUREE_FLO = as.numeric(FIN_FLO - DEBUT_FLO),
         DUREE_P = as.numeric(FIN_EXP - FIN_FLO)) |> 
  mutate(
    m_e = month(DEBUT_EXP),
    d_e = day(DEBUT_EXP),
    fake_year_e = if_else((m_e > 8) | (m_e == 8 & d_e >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    DEBUT_EXP_s = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_e, m_e, d_e)),
    
    m_d = month(DEBUT_CW),
    d_d = day(DEBUT_CW),
    fake_year_d = if_else((m_d > 8) | (m_d == 8 & d_d >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    DEBUT_CW_s = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_d, m_d, d_d)),
    
    m_f = month(FIN_CW),
    d_f = day(FIN_CW),
    fake_year_f = if_else((m_f > 8) | (m_f == 8 & d_f >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    FIN_CW_s = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_f, m_f, d_f)),
    
    m_flo = month(DEBUT_FLO),
    d_flo = day(DEBUT_FLO),
    fake_year_flo = if_else((m_flo > 8) | (m_flo == 8 & d_flo >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    DEBUT_FLO_s = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_flo, m_flo, d_flo)),
    
    m_ff = month(FIN_FLO),
    d_ff = day(FIN_FLO),
    fake_year_ff = if_else((m_ff > 8) | (m_ff == 8 & d_ff >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    FIN_FLO_s = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_ff, m_ff, d_ff)),
    
    m_fe = month(FIN_EXP),
    d_fe = day(FIN_EXP),
    fake_year_fe = if_else((m_fe > 8) | (m_fe == 8 & d_fe >= 15), 2000, 2001),
    FIN_EXP_s = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", fake_year_fe, m_fe, d_fe)),
  ) |> 
  select(PARTENAIRE, ENVIRONNEMENT, YEAR,
         DEBUT_EXP, DEBUT_CW, FIN_CW, DEBUT_FLO, FIN_FLO, FIN_EXP,
         DUREE_AU, DUREE_CW, DUREE_BO, DUREE_FLO, DUREE_P,
         DEBUT_EXP_s, DEBUT_CW_s, FIN_CW_s, DEBUT_FLO_s, FIN_FLO_s, FIN_EXP_s) |> 
  mutate(ZERO = 0, INF = 20000)
```

Regarder la météo
```{r}

read_meteo <- function(link){
  data <- read_excel(link, col_names = FALSE) |> 
    mutate_all(as.character) |> 
    as.data.frame()
  
  
  data <- data[-dim(data)[1], ]
  ph <- which(data[4, ] == "Photoperiode")
  data <- data[, -((ph + 1): dim(data)[2])]
  
  iT <- which(data[1, ] == "TEMPERATURE")
  iEH <- which(data[1, ] == "ETAT HYDRIQUE")
  iR <- which(data[1, ] == "RAYONNEMENT")
  iF <- length(data[1, ])
  iL <- c(rep("", iT-1), rep("TEMP_", iEH - iT), rep("E.HYD_", iR - iEH), rep("RAYO_", iF - iR), "")
  
  colnames(data) <- as.character(paste0(iL, as.vector(data[4, ])))
  
  data <- data[-c(1:4), ]
  
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[7]]), ]
  
  data <- data |> 
    filter(! is.na(DATE))
  
  data <- data[, -c(1:2)]  # 2 ->3
  
  data <- data |> mutate_all(as.numeric)
  data <- data |> mutate(DATE = as_date(DATE, origin = "1899-12-30"))
}

```

# création spline 

```{r}


make_bij_lm_ref <- function(lm, ref) {
  
  # spline 
  fun <- splinefun(x = lm, y = ref, method = "monoH.FC")
  
  fun
}



```


```{r}


make_bij_ref_lm <- function(lm, ref) {
  
  fun <- make_bij_lm_ref(lm, ref)
  
  # inverse numérique 
  f_inv_num <- function(y) {
    
    sapply(y, function(y0) {
      
      
      f_min <- fun(min(ref)) - y0
      f_max <- fun(max(ref)) - y0
      
      if (is.na(f_min) || is.na(f_max) || f_min * f_max > 0) {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
      
      uniroot(
        function(x) fun(x) - y0,
        interval = range(ref),
        tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5
      )$root
    })
  }
  f_inv_num
}


```






# création des splines de ref à lm
```{r}


splines_l <- mapply(
  FUN = function(l_s, nm) {
    l_s <- as.numeric(l_s)
    make_bij_ref_lm(lm = l_s, ref = ref_lm)
  },
  l_s = landmarks_s,
  nm = names(landmarks_s),
  SIMPLIFY = FALSE
)

splines_l <- splines_l[order(names(splines_l))]


```

# création d'une liste avec les jeux de données standardisé pour les landmarks
```{r}

dts_lm_l <- vector("list", length(dts))
names(dts_lm_l) <- noms


name <- "BGA11"

for (name in names(dts)){
  
  l_s <- landmarks_s[[name]] |> as.numeric()
  sp <- splines_l[[name]]
  
  date <- ref_lm[2]:ref_lm[7]
  new_date <- round(sp(date))
  
  dates_on <- data.frame(date_ref = date, DATE_s_n = new_date)
  
  dt <- dts[[name]] |> 
    mutate(DATE_s_n = as.numeric(DATE_s))
  
  dt <- dates_on |> 
    left_join(dt)
  
  dts_lm_l[[name]] <- dt
  
  
  plot(date, new_date, type = "l")  # traits entre les points
  
  points(ref_lm[2:7],
         landmarks_s[[name]][2:7],
         col = "red",
         pch = 16,
         cex = 2)
  
}

dts_lm <- imap_dfr(dts_lm_l, ~ mutate(exp = .y, .x)) |> 
  relocate(exp, .before = 1)

#write.csv(dts_lm, "data/meteo_lm")

summary(dts_lm)


```
